scope: Additive Grand Warden Lavaloon Puppet L1-27 and permanent spawned Lavaloon/Lavaloon Pup audit; temporary event Lavaloons are excluded.
game_version: Official March 2025 and January 2026 changes; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Mashup Mania Event!
sources.version: not published by official launch note
facts: Grand Warden Epic Equipment summons Lavaloons; the number depends on Equipment level.
The page separately labels the returning event Lavaloon as a temporary troop.
sources.limitations: Does not give a complete current level table, child statistics, placement or tick order.

sources.title: January Balance Changes!
facts: The Grand Warden LavaLoon Equipment increases the spawned count from two to three at L21-27.
Spawned Lavaloon housing space is reduced by 8.7% at L1-27.
sources.limitations: The article does not publish an exact integer housing value, child stat table, initial spawn location or timing.

sources.title: Welcome to Clash Anytime Update!
facts: Lavaloon Pup housing space was reduced from two to one.
sources.limitations: This note does not specify Pup creation, stats, death behavior or which Lavaloon variant produces it.

sources.title: History of Updates - What has changed?
facts: The January 2026 change is reported as housing space 23 to 21.
sources.limitations: Secondary summary does not provide client records or other child values.

sources.title: Mashup Mania Event
sources.version: October 2024 event account; current child behavior unverified
facts: The Equipment summons weaker Lavaloons than the separately described temporary event troop.
sources.limitations: The Pup-on-death description occurs under the temporary troop section, so it cannot establish permanent Equipment child behavior.

sources.title: Lavaloon Puppet — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Dated table gives Grand Warden HP bonus 50-150, DPS bonus 10-50, level cap 27 and ore costs.
sources.limitations: Does not provide summon counts, spawned Lavaloon level/stats, housing or Pup mechanics.

sources.title: Pinned Lavaloon Puppet Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Pinned summon counts are one at L1-8, two at L9-20, three at L21-27; spawned Lavaloon level progresses from 1 to 11.
Pinned Warden HP bonus is 50-150 and DPS bonus 10-50.
sources.limitations: The payload has no spawned Lavaloon or Pup combat stats, placement, cadence, or tick order.

derivations.result: Retain pinned summon count, spawned level and Warden bonuses as catalogue data; current L21-27 count has primary corroboration
derivations.method: Compare the pinned 27-level series with the 2024 launch, 2026 balance note and dated 2026 Warden bonus table.

derivations.result: 21 housing space is a secondary reported interpretation of the official 8.7% reduction
derivations.method: Clash Ninja explicitly states 23 to 21; 2/23 rounds to 8.7%. This does not identify any other child statistic.

derivations.result: One housing space is primary supported
derivations.method: Use the March 2025 official two-to-one change without transferring Lava Pup combat values.

rejected_inferences.rule: Reuse temporary event Lavaloon stats or spawn behavior
rejected_inferences.reason: The launch page separates the temporary troop from permanent Equipment; the pinned Equipment record contains no child combat table.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat 8.7% as a combat damage or HP modifier
rejected_inferences.reason: The official change applies to housing space only.

rejected_inferences.rule: Spawn the units immediately at the Warden center in entity-ID order
rejected_inferences.reason: The activation tick, placement formation, collision and ordering are not sourced.

rejected_inferences.rule: Give the Pup ordinary Lava Pup stats or always spawn it on death
rejected_inferences.reason: The primary note only states Lavaloon Pup housing; the secondary launch account describes Pup spawning under the temporary troop section, not the permanent Equipment variant.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply 1-3 summoned units to defending Grand Warden
rejected_inferences.reason: The launch description covers the active attacker Equipment and does not specify defending Hero Equipment behavior.

Warden HP/DPS bonus application and stacking
ability activation, other Equipment order, Warden mode/death and spawn tick
current HP, attack damage, cadence, range, movement, death damage and Pup counts
Air Defense priority and fallback, target selection, path and collision
spawn position, entity-ID order, trap, aura, spell, Clone and Recall interactions
housing 21 confirmation in primary integer game data
parent creation condition, count, level relation and spawn tick
current HP, damage, cadence, movement, targeting, lifetime and death behavior
trap, aura, spell, collision, Viewer art and redistribution rights

conclusion: Lavaloon Puppet L1-27 and its spawned Lavaloon remain partial and catalogue-only. The Pup is a candidate nested child whose relationship to the permanent Equipment variant remains unverified. Summon count L21-27 and Lavaloon/Pup housing changes are documented, but current child combat values, placement and deterministic timing are not; no Equipment or child Core actor is enabled.
